vnh_download() {
    local url="$1"

    if [[ ! "$url" =~ ^https:// ]]; then
        echo "[VNH][INSTALL][ERROR] Only https:// URLs are permitted: $url" >&2

    local tmp="${dest}.vnh.tmp"

            -A "VietnamHosting-UniversalEggs/1.0 (+https://vietnam-hosting.net)" \
            -o "$tmp" "$url"; then
            break
        fi
        rm -f "$tmp"
        if (( attempt == 3 )); then
            echo "[VNH][INSTALL][ERROR] Failed to download ${url}" >&2
            return 1
        fi
        sleep $(( attempt * 2 ))
        attempt=$(( attempt + 1 ))
    done
    if [[ -n "$sha" ]]; then
